title: Matemágico · Serie de Fourier
description: docs/animas/matemagico/README.md § Serie de Fourier: the foe's own silhouette (its surface laid flat and traced round) put through a DFT and drawn back by a chain of circles, the slowest first, one a strike, over the whole silhouette drawn faintly. In the fight tester against three dogs (only the one it is cast on carries anything): nothing, three things, five, Ángulo's mark with Punto débil, and seven (the cap of six); then a castle pupil carrying four, on white plaster. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp = 600; }); });

steps.caption: Cálculo with its new branch off Análisis Parálisis: Serie de Fourier

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; delete f.weakSpot; delete f.statuses; delete f.marks; f.timed = {}; }); const f = s.foes[0];  })

steps.caption: A dog with nothing on its plate: one circle, the dial, draws a plain circle between Gerard and the dog, over the dog's own silhouette drawn faintly (from this high camera a lumpy round); one strike
Nothing on its plate: as it ends

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; delete f.weakSpot; delete f.statuses; delete f.marks; f.timed = {}; }); const f = s.foes[0]; f.timed = { quemado: { level: 2, left: 20, next: 5 }, empolvado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 }, envenenado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 } }; })

steps.caption: Three things on the dog it is cast on, its neighbours clean (Quemado II, Empolvado, Envenenado): four circles. The dial is gold; the three small ones are a few centimetres, so their colours (orange, sand, green) show as beads at the pen. The curve is a blob nearer the faint silhouette than the circle was. Four strikes, outermost first
Three things on its plate: as it ends

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; delete f.weakSpot; delete f.statuses; delete f.marks; f.timed = {}; }); const f = s.foes[0]; f.timed = { quemado: { level: 2, left: 20, next: 5 }, cristalizado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 }, envenenado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 }, mojado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 } }; f.statuses = { sangrado: 3 }; })

steps.caption: Five things on its plate (Sangrado, Quemado II, Cristalizado, Envenenado, Mojado): six circles; the curve (|k| up to 3) follows the silhouette's broad lines, not its legs. Six strikes, each circle closing into a beam of its colour round a gold core, the dog flashing in it, the tone gaining a partial each time
Five things on its plate: as it ends

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; delete f.weakSpot; delete f.statuses; delete f.marks; f.timed = {}; }); const f = s.foes[0]; f.timed = { quemado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 } }; f.weakSpot = s.round; f.marks = { angulo: { amount: 3, stats: ['defensa', 'espiritu'], until: s.round + 2 } }; })

steps.caption: Quemado, Punto débil and Ángulo exacto's ▼ on the dog: four circles (the ▼ counts as one more; Punto débil is an icon of the plate); four strikes, every one tripled, and Punto débil spent
Ángulo's mark and Punto débil: as it ends
